user.title: DEC Deepal S05
user.description: Select the sign-in method used in the official Deepal Spain application.

email.title: Sign in with email
email.description: Enter the email address associated with your Deepal Spain account. You will receive a verification code.

sms.title: Sign in with SMS
sms.description: Enter your Spanish mobile number. You can enter it with or without the +34 prefix.

verification_code.title: Verification code
verification_code.description: Enter the six-digit verification code you received.

error.invalid_mobile: Enter a valid nine-digit Spanish mobile number.
error.send_code_failed: The verification code could not be sent.
error.too_many_codes: Too many verification codes have been requested. Try again later.
error.login_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the verification code.
error.no_vehicles: No vehicles were found for this account.

abort.authentication_state_missing: The authentication process has expired. Start the configuration again.
abort.reauth_vehicle_mismatch: This account is not linked to the vehicle that is already configured. Sign in with the correct account.
